newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi's Arab National Bank plans bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Saudi's Arab National Bank plans bonus issue.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Arab National Bank plans to raise its paid-in capital by 25 percent to 1.5 billion riyals ($400 million) in early 1997 by issuing bonus shares to shareholders, a bank official said on Tuesday.

The bank will grant three million shares worth 300 million riyals to shareholders on a one-for-four basis, paid for from reserves, the official told Reuters by telephone from the bank's headquarters in Riyadh.
Jordan's Arab Bank Ltd holds 40 percent stake of Arab National Bank (ANB). The rest is owned by Saudi investors.
The official said ANB would ask shareholders to ratify the plan in March after it receives permission from the Saudi authorities.
"We are in the process of finalising the plan," he added.
ANB's shares were traded on the Saudi market at around 490 riyals on Monday, a bank official said.
